alm_active_loan_view.name: alm_active_loan_view
alm_active_loan_view.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW alm_active_loan_view
AS
WITH repayment_code AS (
   SELECT cmd.code,
          cmd.value
   FROM mfi_masterdata.code_master_details cmd
   WHERE cmd.code_master_id IN (
	    SELECT id
	    FROM mfi_masterdata.code_master
	    WHERE data_type = 'REPAYMENT_FREQUENCY'
	      AND data_sub_type = 'DEFAULT'
	)
),
active_accounts AS (
    SELECT la.maturity_date,
         la.loan_amount,
         la.term,
         la.expected_disbursement_date,
         la.past_due_days,
         la.first_repayment_date,
         la.account_id,
         la.loan_product_id,
         la.asset_criteria_slabs_id,
         la.asset_classification_slabs_id,
         la.la_office_id as office_id,
         la.customer_id,
         la.la_account_number as account_number,
         la.filler_3
    FROM mfi_accounting.loan_account la
    WHERE la.parent_loan_account_id IS NULL
      AND la.disbursement_status = 'COMPLETED'
      AND la.loan_status IN('ACTIVE', 'DEATH_FORECLOSURE_FREEZE', 'DEATH_FORECLOSURE_FREEZE_RSCH', 'LOCK')
),
 filtered_loan_app AS (
    SELECT id, loan_account_number, constitution
    FROM mfi_los.loan_app
    WHERE is_deleted = false
      AND loan_account_number IS NOT NULL
), group_details AS (
  SELECT id::text AS group_id,
         loan_product_name,
         extensible_json_data
  FROM mfi_los.group_details
  WHERE loan_product_name = 'SHGDL'
), signatory_one_info AS (
  SELECT gmd.group_id::text AS group_id,
         lapp_s1.constitution
  FROM mfi_los.group__member_details gmd
  JOIN mfi_los.loan_app lapp_s1 ON lapp_s1.id = gmd.loan_app_id AND lapp_s1.is_deleted = false
  WHERE gmd.signatory_order = 1 AND gmd.is_deleted = false
)
  SELECT la.account_id as id,
      la.account_number AS account_num,
      'B'::text AS accrualbasis,
      ladf.accrued_interest AS accured_interest,
      o.formatted_id AS branch,
      'INR'::text AS currency_code,
      ladf.total_pos AS current_balance,
      ladf.next_installment_due_date AS due_date,
      rc.value AS pymt_freq,
      aid.effective_rate AS interest_rate,
      p.code AS loan_type,
      la.maturity_date,
      la.loan_amount AS orig_balance,
      la.term AS orig_term,
      la.expected_disbursement_date AS origination_date,
      ladf.next_emi_amount AS installment,
      rc.value AS intt_pymt_freq,
      '7'::text AS pymt_type,
          CASE
              WHEN aid.interest_rate_type::text = 'FIXED'::text THEN 'Fixed'::text
              WHEN aid.interest_rate_type::text = 'FLOATING'::text THEN 'Floating'::text
              ELSE NULL::text
          END AS rate_flag,
          CASE
              WHEN aid.interest_rate_type::text = 'FIXED'::text THEN 'PLR1'::text
              WHEN aid.interest_rate_type::text = 'FLOATING'::text THEN 'Base rate code'::text
              ELSE NULL::text
          END AS reprice_index,
      la.past_due_days AS dpd,
      concat_ws(' ', c.first_name, c.middle_name, c.last_name) AS customer_name,
      ps.id AS scheme_id,
      CASE WHEN p.code = 'SHGDL' THEN gd.extensible_json_data::jsonb -> 'group_psl_json_data' ->>'psl_category_code'  
      ELSE lapd.psl_category_code 
      END AS psl,
          CASE
              WHEN acs.criteria::text = 'STANDARD'::text THEN 'REGULAR'::text
              WHEN acs.criteria::text = 'NPA'::text THEN 'NPA'::text 
              WHEN acs.criteria::text = 'WRITE_OFF'::text THEN 'WRITEOFF'::text
              ELSE NULL::text
          END AS npa_staged_id,
      ladf.inst_start_date,
      CASE WHEN p.code = 'SHGDL' THEN gd.extensible_json_data::jsonb -> 'group_psl_json_data' ->> 'weaker_section_description' ELSE lapd.weaker_section_desc END AS weaker_section_desc,
      ladf.total_pos AS current_book_balance,
      la.first_repayment_date AS first_installment_date,
      '1'::text AS instlnum,
      ladf.paid_emi AS no_of_paid_inst,
      ladf.last_payment_date AS last_inst_recd_date,
          CASE
              WHEN lp.loan_category::text = 'LOAN_JLG'::text THEN 'C'::text
              WHEN lp.loan_category::text = 'LOAN_IND'::text THEN 'I'::text
              ELSE NULL::text
          END AS indv_corp_flag,
          CASE
              WHEN gd.loan_product_name = 'SHGDL' THEN 'BORROWER'::character varying
              ELSE c.customer_type
          END as customer_type,
       LEAST(ladf.loan_acc_gl_bal, 0) AS ub_dr,
       GREATEST(ladf.loan_acc_gl_bal, 0) AS ub_cr,
      ladf.loan_acc_billed_int_gl_balance_d AS oi_dr,
      ladf.loan_acc_billed_int_gl_balance_c AS oi_cr,
      ladf.loan_acc_billed_prin_gl_balance_d AS op_dr,
      ladf.loan_acc_billed_prin_gl_balance_c AS op_cr,
          CASE
              WHEN ladf.suspense_amount < 0::numeric THEN ladf.suspense_amount
              ELSE 0::numeric
          END AS is_dr,
          CASE
              WHEN ladf.suspense_amount > 0::numeric THEN ladf.suspense_amount
              ELSE 0::numeric
          END AS is_cr,
          CASE
              WHEN cl.classification::text = 'DOUB_1'::text THEN 'DBT I'::text
              WHEN cl.classification::text = 'DOUB_2'::text THEN 'DBT II'::text
              WHEN cl.classification::text = 'DOUB_3'::text THEN 'DBT III'::text
              WHEN cl.classification::text = 'LOSS'::text THEN 'LOSS'::text
              WHEN cl.classification::text = 'STD'::text THEN 'STANDARD'::text
              WHEN cl.classification::text = 'SUB_STD'::text THEN 'SUBSTAND'::text
              ELSE NULL::text
          END AS asset_class_id,
      c.formatted_id AS customer_id,
          CASE
              WHEN lp.loan_type::text = 'COLLT_UNSEC'::text THEN 'Un secured'::text
              WHEN lp.loan_type::text = 'COLLT_SEC'::text THEN 'Secured'::text
              ELSE NULL::text
          END AS product_type,
      ladf.suspense_gl_code,
      ladf.account_gl_code,
      ladf.billed_int_gl_code,
      ladf.billed_prin_gl_code,
      CASE WHEN p.code = 'SHGDL' THEN gd.extensible_json_data::jsonb -> 'group_psl_json_data' ->> 'psl_sub_industry_code' ELSE lapd.psl_sub_industry_code END AS sub_industry,
      CASE WHEN p.code = 'SHGDL' THEN soi.constitution ELSE lapp.constitution END AS constitution,
      c.external_id AS ucic
 from
 	active_accounts la
 LEFT JOIN group_details gd ON
 	gd.group_id = la.filler_3
 LEFT JOIN signatory_one_info soi ON
 	soi.group_id = la.filler_3
 JOIN mfi_accounting.loan_account_derived_fields ladf ON
  	ladf.acc_id = la.account_id
 JOIN mfi_accounting.account_interest_details aid ON
 	aid.account_id = la.account_id
 JOIN mfi_accounting.loan_product lp ON
 	lp.id = la.loan_product_id
 JOIN mfi_accounting.product p ON
 	p.id = lp.product_id
 JOIN mfi_accounting.product_scheme ps ON
 	ps.product_id = p.id
 	and ps.is_deleted = false
 JOIN mfi_accounting.asset_criteria_slabs acs ON
 	acs.id = la.asset_criteria_slabs_id
 	and acs.is_deleted = false
 JOIN mfi_accounting.asset_classificatiON_slabs cl ON
 	cl.id = la.asset_classificatiON_slabs_id
 	and cl.is_deleted = false
 JOIN mfi_actor.office o ON
 	o.id = la.office_id
 	and o.is_deleted = false
 JOIN mfi_actor.customer c ON
 	c.id = la.customer_id
 	and c.is_deleted = false
 LEFT JOIN repayment_code rc
   ON rc.code = lp.repayment_frequency
 LEFT JOIN filtered_loan_app lapp ON
 	lapp.loan_account_number = la.account_number
 LEFT JOIN mfi_los.loan_app_psl_data lapd ON
 	lapd.loan_app_id = lapp.id
 	and lapd.is_deleted = false
 ;

alm_closed_loan_view.name: alm_closed_loan_view
alm_closed_loan_view.definition:
CREATE VIEW mfi_reporting.alm_closed_loan_view
AS
WITH signatory_one_info AS (
  SELECT gmd.group_id::text AS group_id,
         lapp_s1.constitution
  FROM mfi_los.group__member_details gmd
  JOIN mfi_los.loan_app lapp_s1 ON lapp_s1.id = gmd.loan_app_id AND lapp_s1.is_deleted = false
  WHERE gmd.signatory_order = 1 AND gmd.is_deleted = false
)
select
	row_number() over (partition by ((
	select
		null::text as text))) as id,
	a.account_number as account_num,
	'B'::text as accrualbasis,
	ladf.accrued_interest as accured_interest,
	o.formatted_id as branch,
	'INR'::text as currency_code,
	ladf.total_pos as current_balance,
	case
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'BIWEEKLY'::text then 'B'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'WEEKLY'::text then 'W'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'DAILY'::text then 'D'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'MONTHLY'::text then 'M'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'QUARTERLY'::text then 'Q'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'HALFYEARLY'::text then 'H'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'YEARLY'::text then 'A'::text
		else null::text
	end as pymt_freq,
	aid.effective_rate as interest_rate,
	p.code as loan_type,
	la.maturity_date,
	la.loan_amount as orig_balance,
	la.term as orig_term,
	la.expected_disbursement_date as origination_date,
	ladf.emi_amount as installment,
	case
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'BIWEEKLY'::text then 'B'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'WEEKLY'::text then 'W'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'DAILY'::text then 'D'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'MONTHLY'::text then 'M'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'QUARTERLY'::text then 'Q'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'HALFYEARLY'::text then 'H'::text
		when lp.repayment_frequency::text = 'YEARLY'::text then 'A'::text
		else null::text
	end as intt_pymt_freq,
	'7'::text as pymt_type,
	case
		when aid.interest_rate_type::text = 'FIXED'::text then 'F'::text
		when aid.interest_rate_type::text = 'FLOATING'::text then 'Floating'::text
		else null::text
	end as rate_flag,
	case
		when aid.interest_rate_type::text = 'FIXED'::text then 'PLR1'::text
		when aid.interest_rate_type::text = 'FLOATING'::text then 'Base rate code'::text
		else null::text
	end as reprice_index,
	la.past_due_days as dpd,
	concat(c.first_name,
	' ',
	c.middle_name,
	' ',
	c.last_name) as customer_name,
	ps.id as scheme_id,
	case
		when lp.loan_category::text = 'LOAN_JLG'::text
		or lp.loan_category::text = 'LOAN_IND'::text then lapd.psl_category_code
        WHEN p.code = 'SHGDL' THEN gd.extensible_json_data::jsonb -> 'group_psl_json_data' ->>'psl_category_code' 
        else null::text
        END AS psl,
	case
		when acs.criteria::text = 'STANDARD'::text then 'REGULAR'::text
		when acs.criteria::text = 'NPA'::text then 'NPA'::text
		when acs.criteria::text = 'WRITE_OFF'::text then 'WRITEOFF'::text
		else null::text
	end as npa_staged_id,
	case
		when lp.loan_category::text = 'LOAN_JLG'::text
		or lp.loan_category::text = 'LOAN_IND'::text then lapd.weaker_section_desc
        WHEN p.code = 'SHGDL' THEN gd.extensible_json_data::jsonb -> 'group_psl_json_data' ->> 'weaker_section_description' 
        else null::text
        END AS weaker_section_desc,
	ladf.total_pos as current_book_balance,
    CASE
        WHEN gd.loan_product_name = 'SHGDL' AND la.parent_loan_account_id IS NULL THEN 'BORROWER'::character varying
        WHEN gd.loan_product_name = 'SHGDL' AND la.parent_loan_account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'CO BORROWER'::character varying
        ELSE c.customer_type
    END as customer_type,
	case
		when cl.classification::text = 'DOUB_1'::text then 'DBT I'::text
		when cl.classification::text = 'DOUB_2'::text then 'DBT II'::text
		when cl.classification::text = 'DOUB_3'::text then 'DBT III'::text
		when cl.classification::text = 'LOSS'::text then 'LOSS'::text
		when cl.classification::text = 'STD'::text then 'STANDARD'::text
		when cl.classification::text = 'SUB_STD'::text then 'SUBSTAND'::text
		else null::text
	end as asset_class_id,
	c.formatted_id as customer_id,
	case
		when lp.loan_type::text = 'COLLT_UNSEC'::text then 'Un secured'::text
		when lp.loan_type::text = 'COLLT_SEC'::text then 'Secured'::text
		else null::text
	end as product_type,
	a.status,
	a.closing_date,
	ladf.paid_emi as no_of_paid_inst,
	ladf.last_payment_date as last_inst_recd_date,
	case
		when lp.loan_category::text = 'LOAN_JLG'::text then 'C'::text
		when lp.loan_category::text = 'LOAN_IND'::text
		or lp.loan_category = 'LOAN_SHG'::text then 'I'::text
		else null::text
	end as indv_corp_flag,
	la.first_repayment_date as first_installment_date,
		CASE
                WHEN ladf.loan_acc_gl_bal < 0::numeric THEN ladf.loan_acc_gl_bal
                ELSE 0::numeric
            END AS ub_dr,
         CASE
                WHEN ladf.loan_acc_gl_bal > 0::numeric THEN ladf.loan_acc_gl_bal
                ELSE 0::numeric
            END AS ub_cr,
    ladf.loan_acc_billed_int_gl_balance_d AS oi_dr,
    ladf.loan_acc_billed_int_gl_balance_c AS oi_cr,
    ladf.loan_acc_billed_prin_gl_balance_d AS op_dr,
    ladf.loan_acc_billed_prin_gl_balance_c AS op_cr,
         CASE
                    WHEN ladf.suspense_amount < 0::numeric THEN ladf.suspense_amount
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS is_dr,
                CASE
                    WHEN ladf.suspense_amount > 0::numeric THEN ladf.suspense_amount
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS is_cr,
    ladf.suspense_gl_code,
	ladf.account_gl_code,
    ladf.billed_int_gl_code,
    ladf.billed_prin_gl_code,
	case
		when p.code = 'SHGDL' then gd.extensible_json_data::jsonb -> 'group_psl_json_data' ->> 'psl_sub_industry_code'
		else lapd.psl_sub_industry_code
	end as sub_industry,
	case
		when p.code = 'SHGDL' then soi.constitution
		else lapp.constitution
	end as constitution,
	c.external_id as ucic
from
	mfi_accounting.account a
join mfi_accounting.loan_account la on
	la.account_id = a.id and la.parent_loan_account_id is null
join mfi_accounting.account_interest_details aid on
	aid.account_id = a.id
join mfi_accounting.loan_product lp on
	lp.id = la.loan_product_id
join mfi_accounting.product p on
	p.id = lp.product_id
join mfi_accounting.product_scheme ps on
	ps.product_id = p.id
join mfi_accounting.asset_criteria_slabs acs on
	acs.id = la.asset_criteria_slabs_id
join mfi_accounting.asset_classification_slabs cl on
	cl.id = la.asset_classification_slabs_id
join mfi_actor.office o on
	o.id = a.office_id
join mfi_actor.customer c on
	c.id = la.customer_id
left join mfi_los.loan_app lapp on
	lapp.loan_account_number::text = a.account_number::text and lapp.is_deleted = false
left join mfi_los.loan_app_psl_data lapd on
	lapd.loan_app_id = lapp.id
	and lapd.is_deleted = false
 join mfi_accounting.loan_account_derived_fields ladf on
	ladf.acc_id = la.account_id
left join mfi_los.group_details gd on
	gd.id::text = la.filler_3
left join signatory_one_info soi on
	soi.group_id = la.filler_3
where
	ps.is_deleted = false
	and acs.is_deleted = false
	and cl.is_deleted = false
	and o.is_deleted = false
	and c.is_deleted = false
	and a.status::text = 'CLOSED'::text ;

cic_group_level_view.name: cic_group_level_view
cic_group_level_view.definition:
CREATE VIEW mfi_reporting.cic_group_level_view AS
WITH group_total_exposure AS (
         SELECT gmd_1.group_id,
            sum(ladf.total_pos) AS sum_total_pos
           FROM mfi_los.group_details gd_1
             JOIN mfi_los.group__member_details gmd_1 ON gd_1.id = gmd_1.group_id
             JOIN mfi_los.loan_app la_1 ON la_1.id = gmd_1.loan_app_id
             JOIN mfi_accounting.loan_account_derived_fields ladf ON ladf.account_number::text = la_1.loan_account_number::text
          GROUP BY gmd_1.group_id
        )
 SELECT row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (( SELECT NULL::text AS text))) AS id,
    gd.formatted_id AS sr_no_jlg,
    o.external_branch_code AS branch_code,
    e1.formatted_id AS so_code,
    e2.formatted_id AS rm_code,
    concat_ws(' '::text, e2.first_name, e2.middle_name, e2.last_name) AS rm_name,
    gd.group_name AS name_of_jlg,
    mc.name AS meeting_center_name,
    concat_ws(','::text, addr.address_line_1, addr.address_line_2, addr.landmark) AS address,
    vtc.name AS village,
    vtc.sub_district AS city_taluk,
    csd.name AS district,
    he4.name AS state,
    addr.pincode AS pin,
        CASE
            WHEN gd.lead_generator::text = 'CSC VLE'::text THEN gd.lead_number
            ELSE 'NA'::character varying
        END AS vle_code,
    o.name AS hdfc_branch_name,
    gd.meeting_date,
    gd.meeting_start_time AS meeting_time,
    ad.beneficiary_account_number AS savings_account_number,
    gd.created_on AS doi,
    gte.sum_total_pos AS total_group_exposure,
    md.members_count AS no_of_members,
    gtd.updated_on AS bet_completion_date,
    concat_ws('-',concat_ws(' ',e.first_name,e.middle_name,e.last_name),e.formatted_id) AS bet_done_by,
    addr.address_geocoded_lat_long AS geo_tagging
   FROM mfi_los.group_details gd
      JOIN mfi_los.group__member_details gmd ON gd.id = gmd.group_id AND gd.is_deleted IS false and gmd.is_signatory_one = true
     join
     (
    SELECT
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS members_count
    FROM
        mfi_los.group__member_details
    WHERE
        is_deleted = FALSE
    GROUP BY
        group_id
    ) md ON md.group_id = gd.id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_los.loan_app la ON la.id = gmd.loan_app_id and gmd.is_deleted = false
     LEFT JOIN mfi_los.group__task_details gtd ON gtd.group_id = gd.id AND gtd.is_deleted = false AND gtd.task_sub_type::text = 'CONDUCT_BET'::text AND gtd.task_status::text = 'COMPLETED'::text
     LEFT JOIN group_total_exposure gte ON gte.group_id = gd.id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.meeting_center mc ON gd.meeting_center_id = mc.id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.address addr ON mc.address_id = addr.id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.village_town_city vtc ON mc.vtc_id = vtc.id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.country_state_district csd ON csd.id = vtc.district_id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.office o ON o.id = la.office_id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.office__address__mapping oam ON oam.office_id = o.id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.address oadd ON oadd.id = oam.address_id AND oadd.type::text = 'ADD_TYP_004'::text
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.hierarchy_element he1 ON he1.id = oadd.geo_element_id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.hierarchy_element he2 ON he2.id = he1.parent
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.hierarchy_element he3 ON he3.id = he2.parent
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.hierarchy_element he4 ON he4.id = he3.parent
     LEFT JOIN mfi_los.account_details ad ON gmd.loan_app_id = ad.loan_app_id AND ad.account_purpose::text = 'REPAYMENT'::text
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor."user" u1 ON u1.id::text = gd.employee_user_id::text
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.employee e1 ON e1.actor_id::text = u1.actor_id::character varying::text
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.employee e2 ON e1.parent_id = e2.id
     left join mfi_actor."user" u on u.id::text = gtd.updated_by
     left join mfi_actor.employee e on e.actor_id = u.actor_id
  WHERE date_trunc('month'::text, la.loan_disbursed_date) = date_trunc('month'::text, now() - '2 mons'::interval)
  GROUP BY gd.formatted_id, o.external_branch_code, e2.first_name, e2.middle_name,
  e2.last_name, e1.formatted_id, e2.formatted_id, gd.group_name, mc.name, addr.address_line_1,
  addr.address_line_2, addr.landmark, vtc.name, o.name, csd.name, he4.name, addr.pincode,
  gd.meeting_date, gd.meeting_start_time, ad.beneficiary_account_number, gd.created_on,
  gtd.updated_on, addr.address_geocoded_lat_long, gtd.updated_by, vtc.sub_district,
  gte.sum_total_pos, la.loan_disbursed_date, gd.id,md.members_count,
  e.first_name,e.middle_name,e.last_name,e.formatted_id;

cic_member_level_view.name: cic_member_level_view
cic_member_level_view.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW mfi_reporting.cic_member_level_view
AS
SELECT row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (( SELECT NULL::text AS text))) AS id,
    gmd.group_id,
    la.id AS loan_application_id,
    p.code AS product_name,
        CASE
            WHEN gmd.is_signatory_one = true THEN 'Yes'::text
            ELSE 'No'::text
        END AS is_aus_one,
        CASE
            WHEN gmd.is_signatory_two = true THEN 'Yes'::text
            ELSE 'No'::text
        END AS is_aus_two,
    concat_ws(' '::text, b.first_name, b.middle_name, b.last_name) AS name,
    'NA'::text AS sourcing_channel,
        CASE
            WHEN b.marital_status::text = 'MARRIED'::text THEN b.spouse_name
            ELSE b.parent_name
        END AS wife_or_daughter_of,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN kyc_subquery.rn = 1 THEN kyc_subquery.document_name
            ELSE NULL::text
        END) AS kyc_one_name,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN kyc_subquery.rn = 1 THEN kyc_subquery.document_id
            ELSE NULL::character varying
        END::text) AS kyc_one_id,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN kyc_subquery.rn = 2 THEN kyc_subquery.document_name
            ELSE NULL::text
        END) AS kyc_two_name,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN kyc_subquery.rn = 2 THEN kyc_subquery.document_id
            ELSE NULL::character varying
        END::text) AS kyc_two_id,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN kyc_subquery.rn = 3 THEN kyc_subquery.document_name
            ELSE NULL::text
        END) AS kyc_three_name,
    max(
        CASE
            WHEN kyc_subquery.rn = 3 THEN kyc_subquery.document_id
            ELSE NULL::character varying
        END::text) AS kyc_three_id,
    ad.beneficiary_bank AS bank_name,
    ad.beneficiary_account_number AS savings_bank_account_no,
    b.mobile_number AS phone,
    concat_ws(','::text, addr.address_line_1, addr.address_line_2, addr.landmark, addr.locality, addr.pincode) AS address,
    ladf.total_pos AS pos,
    lid.installment_amount AS last_emi_amount,
    lid.installment_date AS last_emi_paid_date,
    la.loan_disbursed_date AS disbursement_date,
    CURRENT_DATE AS pos_date,
    concat_ws(' '::text, la.loan_term, la.term_unit) AS loan_tenure
   FROM mfi_los.loan_app la
     LEFT JOIN mfi_los.group__member_details gmd ON gmd.loan_app_id = la.id AND gmd.is_deleted = false
     LEFT JOIN mfi_accounting.loan_account_derived_fields ladf ON ladf.account_number::text = la.loan_account_number::text
     LEFT JOIN mfi_los.borrower b ON b.loan_app_id = la.id AND b.borrower_type::text = 'BORROWER'::text AND b.is_deleted = false
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.customer cust ON cust.id = b.customer_id_borrower AND cust.status::text = 'ACTIVE'::text
     LEFT JOIN mfi_accounting.product p ON p.id = la.loan_product_id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_los.account_details ad ON ad.loan_app_id = la.id AND ad.account_purpose::text = 'DISBURSEMENT'::text
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.actor a ON a.id = cust.actor_id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.actor__address__mapping adm ON adm.actor_id = a.id
     LEFT JOIN mfi_actor.address addr ON addr.id = adm.address_id AND addr.type::text = 'CORRESPONDENCE'::TEXT
     LEFT JOIN mfi_accounting.account acc ON acc.account_number::text = la.loan_account_number::text
     LEFT JOIN mfi_accounting.loan_installment_details lid ON lid.loan_account_id = acc.id AND lid.is_deleted = false AND lid.serial_number = 2
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ladd.loan_app_id,
            ladd.document_name,
            ladd.document_id,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY kdd.loan_app_id ORDER BY ladd.id) AS rn
           FROM mfi_los.kyc_document_details kdd
             LEFT JOIN mfi_los.loan_app__document_details ladd ON ladd.id = kdd.document_image_id
          WHERE kdd.entity_type::text = 'BORROWER'::TEXT) kyc_subquery ON kyc_subquery.loan_app_id = la.id
  WHERE date_trunc('month'::text, la.loan_disbursed_date) = date_trunc('month'::text, now() - '2 mons'::interval) AND addr.is_deleted IS FALSE
  GROUP BY gmd.group_id, la.id, p.code, gmd.is_signatory_one, gmd.is_signatory_two, b.first_name, b.middle_name, b.last_name, b.marital_status, b.spouse_name, b.parent_name, ad.beneficiary_bank, ad.beneficiary_account_number, b.mobile_number, addr.address_line_1, addr.address_line_2, addr.landmark, addr.locality, addr.pincode, lid.installment_amount, lid.installment_date, la.loan_disbursed_date, ladf.total_pos;

combined_view_of_cheque_bounce.name: combined_view_of_cheque_bounce
combined_view_of_cheque_bounce.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW mfi_reporting.combined_view_of_cheque_bounce
AS SELECT row_number() OVER () AS id,
    filtered_data.loan_account_id,
    filtered_data.account_number,
    filtered_data.mandate_category,
    filtered_data.mandate_reference_number,
    filtered_data.amount,
    filtered_data.presentation_date,
    filtered_data.value_date,
    filtered_data.bank_name,
    filtered_data.reject_reason,
    filtered_data.row_num
   FROM ( SELECT combined_data.loan_account_id,
            combined_data.mandate_category,
            combined_data.mandate_reference_number,
            combined_data.amount,
            combined_data.presentation_date,
            combined_data.bank_name,
            combined_data.reject_reason,
            combined_data.value_date,
            combined_data.account_number,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY combined_data.loan_account_id ORDER BY combined_data.presentation_date DESC) AS row_num
           FROM ( SELECT cheque_bounce_extractor_si_view.loan_account_id,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_view.mandate_category,

                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_view.value_date,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_view.account_number
                   FROM mfi_reporting.cheque_bounce_extractor_si_view
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_view.loan_account_id,

                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_view.mandate_reference_number,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_view.amount,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_view.presentation_date,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_view.bank_name,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_view.reject_reason,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_view.value_date,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_view.account_number
                   FROM mfi_reporting.cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_view
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_rep_view.loan_account_id,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_rep_view.mandate_category,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_rep_view.mandate_reference_number,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_rep_view.amount,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_rep_view.presentation_date,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_rep_view.bank_name,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_rep_view.reject_reason,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_rep_view.value_date,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_rep_view.account_number
                   FROM mfi_reporting.cheque_bounce_extractor_enach_rep_view
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT cheque_bounce_extractor_si_manual_view.loan_account_id,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_manual_view.mandate_category,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_manual_view.mandate_reference_number,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_manual_view.amount,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_manual_view.presentation_date,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_manual_view.bank_name,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_manual_view.reject_reason,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_manual_view.value_date,
                    cheque_bounce_extractor_si_manual_view.account_number

  WHERE filtered_data.row_num <= 3;

credit_productivity_report_view.name: credit_productivity_report_view
credit_productivity_report_view.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW mfi_reporting.credit_productivity_report_view
AS with group_task_detailed as (
         select distinct on (gtd.group_id,e.formatted_id)
         	gtd.group_id,
         	gtd.task_id,
         	gtd.updated_on,
         	case when t.assignee_contributor  is not null then t.assignee_contributor::text  else gtd.updated_by end as assignee_contributor,
         	(select 1 from mfi_los.group__task_details gtd_ap where gtd_ap.group_id =gtd.group_id and gtd_ap.task_sub_type in('ESIGN_PENDING','CAPTURE_DOT_ACCOUNT','VERIFY_DOT_ACCOUNT') limit 1) as approved,
   		(select 1 from mfi_los.group_details gd_ap where gd_ap.id =gtd.group_id and gd_ap.group_status in('Rejected') limit 1) as reject,
         	concat_ws(' '::text, e.first_name, e.middle_name, e.last_name) as employee_name,
         	gtd.task_status,
         	e.formatted_id,
         	gtd.created_on
         from
         	mfi_los.group__task_details gtd
         left join mfi_task.task t on
         	t.id = gtd.task_id
         	 left join mfi_actor."user" u on
         	case when t.assignee_contributor  is not null then t.assignee_contributor::text  else gtd.updated_by end = u.id::text
         left join mfi_actor.employee e on
         	e.actor_id = u.actor_id
         where
         	gtd.task_sub_type::text = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING'::text
         	and t.current_status not in('UN_ASSIGNED') ),
   		ranked_group_tasks as (select *,row_number() over (partition by group_id
         order by
         	task_id) as rn from group_task_detailed),
         loan_task_detailed as (
         select distinct on (latd.loan_app_id,e.formatted_id)
         	latd.loan_app_id,
         	latd.task_id,
         	latd.updated_on,
         	case when t.assignee_contributor is not null then t.assignee_contributor::bigint  else latd.updated_by::bigint end  as user_id,
         	latd.task_status,
         	t.current_status,
         	concat_ws(' '::text, e.first_name, e.middle_name, e.last_name) as employee_name,
         	e.formatted_id,
         	latd.created_on,
         (select 1 from mfi_los.loan_app__task_details latd_ap where latd_ap.loan_app_id =latd.loan_app_id and latd_ap.task_sub_type in('ESIGN_PENDING','CAPTURE_DOT_ACCOUNT','VERIFY_DOT_ACCOUNT') limit 1) as approved,
        (select 1 from mfi_los.loan_app la_ap where la_ap.id =latd.loan_app_id and la_ap.status in('Rejected') limit 1) as reject
   	 from
         	mfi_los.loan_app__task_details latd
         left join mfi_task.task t on
         	t.id = latd.task_id
         	left join mfi_actor."user" u on
         	case when t.assignee_contributor is not null then t.assignee_contributor::text  else latd.updated_by::text end = u.id::text
         left join mfi_actor.employee e on
         	e.actor_id = u.actor_id
         where
         	latd.task_sub_type::text = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING'::text
         	and t.current_status not in('UN_ASSIGNED') ),
   		ranked_loan_tasks as (select *,	row_number() over (partition by loan_app_id
         order by
         	task_id) as rn from loan_task_detailed),
       final_loan_cu as (
         select distinct on (rlt_1.loan_app_id)
             rlt_1.loan_app_id,
             rlt_1.updated_on,
             rlt_1.employee_name,
             rlt_1.user_id,
             rlt_1.formatted_id,
             rlt_1.task_status
         from ranked_loan_tasks rlt_1
         where rlt_1.approved = 1 or rlt_1.reject = 1
         order by rlt_1.loan_app_id, rlt_1.rn desc
      ),
      final_group_cu as (
         select distinct on (rgt_1.group_id)
             rgt_1.group_id,
             rgt_1.updated_on,
             rgt_1.employee_name,
             rgt_1.assignee_contributor,
             rgt_1.task_status,
             rgt_1.formatted_id
         from ranked_group_tasks rgt_1
         where rgt_1.approved = 1 or rgt_1.reject = 1
         order by rgt_1.group_id, rgt_1.rn desc
      ),
         formatted_date_cte as (
         select
         	to_char(to_timestamp((c.prop_value::bigint / 1000)::double precision), 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text)::date as formatted_business_date
         from
         	mfi_masterdata.configuration c
         where
         	c.prop_key::text ~~ 'current.business.date'::text )
         select
         	distinct on
         	(la.formatted_id) row_number() over () as id,
         	la.formatted_id as app_id_c,
         	concat_ws(' '::text, b.first_name, b.middle_name, b.last_name) as customer_name,
         	gd.formatted_id as group_id,
         	gd.group_name,
         	o.formatted_id as branch_id,
         	o.name as branch,
         	o.description as region,
         	he4.name as state,
         	o.external_branch_code as hubs,
         	vtc.name as village,
         	la.loan_product_code as product,
         	la.requested_amount as loan_applied_amt,
         	la.approved_amount as loan_approved_amt,
         	case
         		when la.loan_type::text = 'ETB'::text then 'Y'::text
         		else 'N'::text
         	end as existing_customer,
         	case
         		when la.rtr_flag = true then 'Y'::text
         		else 'N'::text
         	end as is_rtr,
          (b.extensible_json_data::jsonb ->> 'previous_loan_account_number')::text as finnone_lan_no,
         	b.ucic as finw_cust_id,
         	la.loan_purpose,
         	case
         		when la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'::text then max( case when rlt.rn = 1 then rlt.created_on else null::timestamp without time zone end)
         		else max( case when rgt.rn = 1 then rgt.created_on else null::timestamp without time zone end)
         	end as file_sent_to_credit_date,
         	case
         		when la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'::text then max( case when rlt.rn = 1 then rlt.updated_on else null::timestamp without time zone end)
         		else max( case when rgt.rn = 1 then rgt.updated_on else null::timestamp without time zone end)
         	end as first_cu_date_time,
         	case
         		when la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'::text then max( case when rlt.rn = 1 then rlt.formatted_id else null::character varying end::text)
         		else max( case when rgt.rn = 1 then rgt.formatted_id else null::character varying end::text)
         	end as first_cu_user_id,
         	case
         		when la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'::text then max( case when rlt.rn = 1 then rlt.employee_name else null::text end)
         		else max( case when rgt.rn = 1 then rgt.employee_name else null::text end)
         	end as first_cu_user_name,
         	case
         		when la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'::text then max( case when rlt.rn = 2 then rlt.updated_on else null::timestamp without time zone end)
         		else max( case when rgt.rn = 2 then rgt.updated_on else null::timestamp without time zone end)
         	end as second_cu_date_time,
         	case
         		when la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'::text then max( case when rlt.rn = 2 then rlt.formatted_id else null::character varying end::text)
         		else max( case when rgt.rn = 2 then rgt.formatted_id else null::character varying end::text)
         	end as second_cu_user_id,
         	case
         		when la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'::text then max( case when rlt.rn = 2 then rlt.employee_name else null::text end)
         		else max( case when rgt.rn = 2 then rgt.employee_name else null::text end)
         	end as second_cu_user_name,
         	case
         		when la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'::text
         		and rlt_emp.task_status ::text in ('COMPLETED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text) then rlt_emp.updated_on
         		when rgt_emp.task_status ::text in ('COMPLETED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text) then rgt_emp.updated_on
         		when la.status in ('Credit Underwriting Pending', 'Rejected', 'Hold For Clarification')
         		and (exists (
         		select
         			1
         		from
         			mfi_los.group__task_details gtd
         		where
         			gtd.group_id = gd.id
         			and gtd.task_sub_type::text = 'HOLD_FOR_CLARIFICATION' and gtd.task_status = 'ASSIGNED') or exists (
         		select
         			1
         		from
         			mfi_los.loan_app__task_details latd
         		left join mfi_los.loan_app la on
         			latd.loan_app_id = la.id
         			where latd.task_sub_type::text = 'HOLD_FOR_CLARIFICATION' and latd.task_status = 'ASSIGNED')) then null
         	end as final_cu_date_time,
         	case
         		when la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'::text
         		and rlt_emp.task_status ::text in ('COMPLETED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text) then rlt_emp.formatted_id
         		when rgt_emp.task_status ::text in ('COMPLETED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text) then rgt_emp.formatted_id
         		when la.status in ('Credit Underwriting Pending', 'Rejected', 'Hold For Clarification')
         		and (exists (
         		select
         			1
         		from
         			mfi_los.group__task_details gtd
         		where
         			gtd.group_id = gd.id
         			and gtd.task_sub_type::text = 'HOLD_FOR_CLARIFICATION' and gtd.task_status = 'ASSIGNED') or exists (
         		select
         			1
         		from
         			mfi_los.loan_app__task_details latd
         		left join mfi_los.loan_app la on
         			latd.loan_app_id = la.id
         			where latd.task_sub_type::text = 'HOLD_FOR_CLARIFICATION' and latd.task_status = 'ASSIGNED')) then null
         	end as final_cu_user_id,
         	case
         		when la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'::text
         		and rlt_emp.task_status ::text in ('COMPLETED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text) then rlt_emp.employee_name
         		when rgt_emp.task_status ::text in ('COMPLETED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text) then rgt_emp.employee_name
         		when la.status in ('Credit Underwriting Pending', 'Rejected', 'Hold For Clarification')
         		and (exists (
         		select
         			1
         		from
         			mfi_los.group__task_details gtd
         		where
         			gtd.group_id = gd.id
         			and gtd.task_sub_type::text = 'HOLD_FOR_CLARIFICATION' and gtd.task_status = 'ASSIGNED') or exists (
         		select
         			1
         		from
         			mfi_los.loan_app__task_details latd
         			left join mfi_los.loan_app la on
         			latd.loan_app_id = la.id
         			where latd.task_sub_type::text = 'HOLD_FOR_CLARIFICATION' and latd.task_status = 'ASSIGNED')) then null
         	end as final_cu_user_name,
         	case
         		when (rlt_emp.task_status ::text in ('COMPLETED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text)
         			or rgt_emp.task_status ::text in ('COMPLETED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text)) then cumd.cu_decision
         			when (rlt_emp.task_status ::text in ('COMPLETED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text)
         			or rgt_emp.task_status ::text in ('COMPLETED'::text, 'CLOSED'::text))and cumd.cu_decision is null then labd.bet_decision
         	end as cu_decision,
         	case
         		when (la.status in('Rejected')
         			or gd.group_status = 'Rejected')
         		and la.loan_product_code::text != 'INDL_LOAN'::text
         		and exists (
         		select
         			1
         		from
         			mfi_los.group__task_details gtd
         		where
         			gtd.group_id = gd.id
         			and gtd.task_sub_type::text = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' ) then 'Rejected'
         		when la.status not in ('Credit Underwriting Pending', 'Rejected', 'Hold For Clarification')
         		and exists (
         		select
         			1
         		from
         			mfi_los.group__task_details gtd
         		where
         			gtd.group_id = gd.id
         			and gtd.task_sub_type::text = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING' )
         		and la.loan_product_code::text != 'INDL_LOAN'::text then 'Approved'
         		else null
         	end as cu_group_decision,
         	case
         		when la.is_stp = true then 'Y'::text
         		else 'N'::text
         	end as is_stp,
         CASE
             WHEN (
                 (la.status IN ('Rejected','Cancelled') OR gd.group_status = 'Rejected')
                 AND la.loan_product_code::text != 'INDL_LOAN'
                 AND EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM mfi_los.group__task_details gtd2
                     WHERE gtd2.group_id = gd.id
                     AND gtd2.task_sub_type::text = 'CREDIT_UNDERWRITING'
                 )
             ) THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(gd.rejected_reason, ''),NULLIF(la.reject_reason, ''))
             WHEN (
                 cu_decision = 'DELINK'
                 AND la.loan_product_code::text = 'INDL_LOAN'
             ) THEN NULLIF(la.reject_reason, '')
             ELSE NULL
         END AS rejected_reason,
          rgt_emp.task_status
         from
         	mfi_los.loan_app la
         left join mfi_los.borrower b on
         	b.loan_app_id = la.id
         	and b.borrower_type::text = 'BORROWER'::text
         left join (
         	select
         		max(group__member_details.id) as max_id,
         		group__member_details.group_id,
         		group__member_details.loan_app_id
         	from
         		mfi_los.group__member_details
         	group by
         		group__member_details.group_id,
         		group__member_details.loan_app_id) gmd on
         	la.id = gmd.loan_app_id
         left join mfi_los.group_details gd on
         	gmd.group_id = gd.id
         left join mfi_los.group__task_details gtd on
         	gd.id = gtd.group_id
         left join mfi_los.loan_app__task_details latd on
         	la.id = latd.loan_app_id
         left join ranked_group_tasks rgt on
         	gd.id = rgt.group_id
         left join ranked_loan_tasks rlt on
         	la.id = rlt.loan_app_id
         left join final_loan_cu rlt_emp on
         	la.id = rlt_emp.loan_app_id
         left join final_group_cu rgt_emp on
         	gd.id = rgt_emp.group_id
         left join mfi_actor.office o on
         	o.id = la.office_id
         left join mfi_actor.office__address__mapping oam on
         	oam.office_id = o.id
         left join mfi_actor.address oadd on
         	oadd.id = oam.address_id
         	and oadd.type::text = 'ADD_TYP_004'::text
         left join mfi_actor.hierarchy_element he1 on
         	he1.id = oadd.geo_element_id
         left join mfi_actor.hierarchy_element he2 on
         	he2.id = he1.parent
         left join mfi_actor.hierarchy_element he3 on
         	he3.id = he2.parent
         left join mfi_actor.hierarchy_element he4 on
         	he4.id = he3.parent
         left join mfi_actor.village_town_city vtc on
         	vtc.id = la.vtc_id
         left join mfi_los.draft_borrowers db on
         	db.loan_app_id = la.id
         join mfi_los.loan_app__cu_member_details cumd on
         	cumd.loan_app_id = la.id
         	join mfi_los.loan_app__bet_details labd on
         	labd.loan_app_id = la.id
         where
         	case
         		when la.status::text = 'Disbursed'::text then la.loan_disbursed_date::date >= date_trunc('month'::text, (( select formatted_date_cte.formatted_business_date from formatted_date_cte))::timestamp with time zone)
         		and la.loan_disbursed_date::date <= (((
         		select
         			formatted_date_cte.formatted_business_date
         		from
         			formatted_date_cte)) - '1 day'::interval)
         		when la.status::text = any (array['Cancelled'::character varying,
         		'Rejected'::character varying]::text[]) then la.updated_on::date >= date_trunc('month'::text, (( select formatted_date_cte.formatted_business_date from formatted_date_cte))::timestamp with time zone)
         		and la.updated_on::date <= (((
         		select
         			formatted_date_cte.formatted_business_date
         		from
         			formatted_date_cte)) - '1 day'::interval)
         		else la.created_on::date >= date_trunc('month'::text, (( select formatted_date_cte.formatted_business_date from formatted_date_cte))::timestamp with time zone)

create view mfi_reporting.village_details_aoo_view as
select vtc.id as mapping_id, csd2.name as state_name,csd2.code as state_code,csd.name as district_name,csd.code as district_code ,vtc.sub_district,
vtc.name as village_name, vtc.census_code , vtc.category ,vrm.risk_category , ovm.office_id , o.formatted_id , o.name as office_name
from mfi_actor.village_town_city vtc
left join  mfi_actor.country_state_district csd on csd.id = vtc.district_id
left join mfi_actor.country_state_district csd2 on csd2.id = csd.parent_id
left join mfi_actor.village_risk_mapping vrm on vtc.id = vrm.vtc_id
left join mfi_actor.office_vtc_mapping ovm on vtc.id = ovm.vtc_id and ovm.is_deleted = false
left join mfi_actor.office o on ovm.office_id = o.id order by csd2.name , csd.name ;
